findings.evidence: Section 7.3.2 (book page 149, PDF p.173): "At 262,144 cached tokens, this component occupies 16 GiB (17,179,869,184 B ≈ 17.18 GB on the chapter's decimal GB basis, §7.1). This analytical result assumes one sequence and unsharded raw tensors." Followed by: "[1P][FACT] for the configuration; [1P][DERIVED] for the storage."
findings.issue: Missing provenance label for the chosen context length input. The storage figure (16 GiB at 262,144 tokens) is labeled [1P][DERIVED] — correctly derived from the Qwen3.8-27B configuration ([1P][FACT]). However, 262,144 tokens is a deliberately chosen context-length input for the calculation, not a value stated in the Qwen3.8-27B configuration. Per the Preface (p.14): "[ASSUMPTION] — a deliberately chosen scenario input" and per the exception test (p.15): "a number that any downstream figure depends on is labeled." The same applies to the 131,072-token figure in the next paragraph: "At 131,072 tokens the same component is 8 GiB (8,589,934,592 B ≈ 8.59 GB decimal)." Neither context length carries its own provenance/epistemic label — they are chosen inputs that should carry an [ASSUMPTION] tag (or [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] if non-canonical) alongside the [1P][DERIVED] storage figure.
findings.fix_instruction: Add provenance labels for the chosen context lengths: e.g., change "At 262,144 cached tokens, this component occupies 16 GiB" to explicitly label 262,144 as an [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] input (or [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION] if it belongs to the canonical set — but it doesn't appear in Table 4-2, so [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] is correct). Similarly for 131,072. The [1P][FACT] and [1P][DERIVED] labels already on the configuration and storage respectively can remain; add the missing label for the input.

findings.evidence: p.177: "The same caution applies to safetensors: storing tensors in a recognized container does not establish that a loader understands their quantized schema. [1P][DERIVED] (GGUF specification, pinned revision, retrieved 2026-10-28)." Book definition (p.16): "DERIVED — computed by arithmetic from stated inputs."
findings.issue: Evidence-label mismatch: the tagged sentence is a reasoned caution about container/loader behavior, not a value computed by arithmetic from stated inputs, so [1P][DERIVED] does not match the book's own Axis-2 definition. The GGUF-spec facts earlier in the paragraph are [1P][FACT]-type content; the caution is the book's own inference.
findings.fix_instruction: Retag: spec-content statements as [1P][FACT] (GGUF/safetensors specifications, pinned revisions), and the load-rejection caution as untagged reasoned guidance or [1P][HYPOTHESIS]; reserve [DERIVED] for arithmetic results.
